_comment: Per-player bio for the stats site, keyed by the box-score name. 'position' (PG/SG/SF/PF/C or hyphenated), 'nickname' (shown under the name, BBref-style), 'jersey' (squad number, e.g. 22 — shown as 'No.' on the profile header), and optional 'full_name' override. Leave a value as "" to hide it. Run build.bat after editing.
